description: Add or upsert rate components on a DRAFT ComponentPriced price book. Components are keyed by their string key: a component whose key already exists is overwritten, so re-sending after an interruption is safe. Use this to load the parametric cost model (text printing, cover paper, binding, etc.) that a ComponentPriced book resolves — it replaces the grid that a SpecPriced book would use. After loading all components, call evaluate_price_book then activate_price_book.

bookId.description: The DRAFT ComponentPriced price book id (GUID).

components.description: Rate components to add/upsert. Each needs: key (unique machine key), label, basis (PerCopy | PerUnitPerCopy | FlatPerOrder), rates (list of {specKey, minimumQuantity, rate}). Optional: basisAttributeKey (required for PerUnitPerCopy), rateKeyAttributes, appliesWhen (condition tree), excludeFromMarkup, clamp ({minPerOrder, maxPerOrder}).
